instructions: Moi file firmware co product, bootloaderSHA256 va build vid rieng. App doc /json/info.product de chon firmware, so khop bootloaderSHA256, sau do moi compare vid cua file da match. Thay url, size va sha256 bang file bin that truoc khi upload len server.

latest.notes: Build 2611171 cho ESP32-S3 N8R8. Co 3 file rieng cho HW board ARGB HSL Controller 4X, ARGB HSL Controller 2X Pro va ARGB HSL Controller 16X.

files.notes: Build 2611171 cho ARGB HSL Controller 4X: tab Timecode (dung voi Tool ARGB HSL v3.17.8 tro len): xem thu hieu ung ngay tren ca mach hoac rieng tung phan doan, mach giu nguyen bo cuc va khong luu ban xem thu; sau khi phat show, bam xem thu hay doi tren web thi mach tu tra lai trang thai truoc show, khong con bi logo cua show che mat. Show va nut bam cu van chay nhu truoc.
